reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience with the three-week board and train program for Summit, my 1.5-year-old husky/shepherd mix. We worked with Angel G., and I couldn’t be happier with the progress Summit made.

Summit came to us from a shelter and, while he’s a great dog, he was definitely stubborn when it came to basic commands, listening consistently, and especially recall. The difference after three weeks with Angel is incredible. His recall has improved tremendously, he listens to his commands much more consistently, and overall he seems much more focused and responsive.

Angel did a fantastic job working with Summit and gave us a great foundation to continue building on at home. I also really appreciated the time he took to teach us how to reinforce the training so that Summit can continue progressing. It’s obvious that Angel genuinely cares about the dogs he works with and takes pride in seeing them succeed.

I’m extremely happy with the experience and would absolutely recommend Angel and the board and train program to anyone looking for professional dog training. I’m excited to keep working with Summit and building on everything he learned!

Alexis was amazing! I signed my dog up for the two week board and train. She is an adopted 3 year old lab who had very little training and was very wild! She still has her energy, but the work Alexis did helped to calm her in every way- from greeting people and not jumping, listening better and going on walks (which used to be miserable). There is still more work to be done as she transitions from her training environment to home, but Alexis has provided me with the tools and support needed so my dog can continue to improve!

Also, I really appreciated the report cards every other day with a ton of photos and videos so I knew what was happening. Could not be happier with the entire experience!

Angel did an outstanding job with my dog, Vita! She was so reactive to other dogs and people, but after Angel took her through his 3 week training, she is so good in public! This is her practicing her Place/Down at The Pearl this evening.

10/10 RECOMMEND!!

Thank you Alexis!!

My husband and I did the 2 week board and train program with Alexis!
We have an 8 year old terrier mix and a 4 year old Golden Retriever.
We are absolutely over the moon with how well the program worked!! Alexis truly cares for the animals she is working with and takes the training very seriously! She sends report cards out Monday, Wednesday and Fridays, and she is so detailed and honest! She lets you know where they are excelling and where they still need work. She attaches photos and videos of her working with your pets and it’s amazing to see!
We met up at La Cantera to do some training and to show me how to work with them moving forward,  Alexis made it so easy! She explained everything so perfectly and made it so easy for me to recreate the commands! She made me feel confident and so excited to continue their training at home!!

We are so happy!!

We are beyond grateful for Angel’s wonderful work with our 6-month old Labradoodle Henry. We really appreciated the consistent updates with photos and videos during the course of the training so we could be a part of all of his adventures around San Antonio.

Henry has been doing great and all of us have gained confidence through this process.

It is apparent that Angel is passionate about training dogs and us owners alike. We highly recommend Camp Lucky to anyone looking for help training their dog!

I cannot say enough great things about Angel! He worked with my five-month-old golden retriever, and the results were beyond impressive. My pup went from being a wild, excitable ball of energy to a well-mannered, responsive companion all thanks to Angel’s patient, consistent, and kind approach.

Angel clearly understands dog behavior and was just as great at training me as the owner! He explained each step of the process, provided helpful tips I could use at home, and were always available for questions.

If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares about your dog and delivers real results, Angel is the one. Highly recommend to anyone needing a skilled and trustworthy trainer!

We used Camp Lucky for a two week board and train with the phenomenal trainer, Angel. Our poodle puppy came back incredibly well trained, more confident, and obedient than we could have imagined. It has made her life and ours all the better. We have so much more confidence in her manners, her off leash recall, and socialization too. Angel is highly professional and attentive and provided an in depth multi-hour hand off when we picked up our dog. We feel like we learned just as much as our dog from him. We would absolutely recommend Angel and Camp Lucky to anyone looking for training.

Angel was fantastic with our 10 month old standard poodle. He gave us frequent updates on her progress as well as lots of pictures. We felt complete confidence she was in good hands. The turn over at the end of training was super thorough and informative. We would recommend him and camp lucky to anyone!

I researched for a training program for my dogs for a while and I finally decided to take them both for training. One dog did a week and another two weeks. I am extremely happy with the results. Angel is a very good trainer and very thorough. I loved receiving report cards on them and pictures and videos to see their progress but also guide me when I needed to see his technique. After training was over he spent a little over 3 hours going through every single thing he trained them on and walked us through everything. The biggest problem was the non stop barking and one dog was more aggressive than the other. Also, begging for food while eating and not leaving my site when cooking. All of the things added up and I didn’t realize how much  work had to be done. I can now cook in peace and eat in peace. He's trained them to young ladies with manners :)  Angel was straightforward about giving us the tools, but we need to continue this training and he’s correct. The dogs are doing great and it’s only been a coupleOf weeks. I’m so happy we have the tools Now and are able to enjoy a quieter home and they actually listen!! :)

***1 month update***
I can not express how thankful I am for Angel! Both dogs are doing amazing and just keep getting better each day. I wish I would have done the training sooner. I work from home and used to be anxious I had to make a calling because I was scared for the. On stop barking. I don’t feel that at all anymore. My dogs are calm and it’s been an amazing transformation. A huge concern was when people would come over and that’s also been a great change. Others have noticed and also can’t believe the change. I remember thinking I’d be happy if there was just even a small change because I felt that desperate and to be honest I wasn’t convinced for sure it would be as effective. I know each dog is different but I can say it’s effective and it’s made a huge difference. Thanks again!

We had an incredible experience with our dog’s training, thanks to Angel at Camp Lucky's San Antonio location. After researching several trainers, comparing prices, and evaluating expertise, we chose Camp Lucky and couldn’t have made a better decision. From the moment we called for information, Aaron the owner provided a 10/10 experience. They patiently walked us through the entire process without pressuring us, ensuring we felt confident and informed about their program.

When it came to training, Angel was exceptional. As first-time dog owners, we were nervous about leaving our dog, Hunner, for the two-week program. Angel went above and beyond to meet with us beforehand, listen to our concerns, and develop a personalized training plan tailored to Hunter’s needs and our goals. His professionalism, attention to detail, and ability to connect with both us and Hunner put our minds at ease. I loved the idea of Angel providing us with reports, pictures, and videos throughout the duration of the program. It made us feel that the program was really working!

Before training, Hunter was a lovable but overly energetic rescue pup. We got him at around 8 to 9 months old, he struggled with hyperactivity, leash biting, and difficulty settling down. Walks were stressful and avoided in public settings, we couldn’t enjoy time on the couch without him biting us wanting to play or throwing tantrums. Previous attempts at training, including group sessions at PetSmart, were unsuccessful and left us feeling discouraged that we could ever enjoy having a puppy we could take out in public or even relax in our own home.

Angel’s training transformed Hunner into a completely different dog. By the end of the program, Hunner was calm, focused, and well-behaved. We could finally relax as a family in our home, enjoy peaceful walks, and even take him to public places with confidence. The true test came during the holiday season when we flew on a four-hour flight with Hunner. His impeccable behavior amazed everyone, from airport staff to fellow passengers. He remained calm, quiet, and on command throughout the journey—so much so that many couldn’t believe a dog was even on the plane!

Our family back home was equally impressed, commenting on how well-trained and obedient Hunter had become. This program not only gave us peace of mind as dog owners but also made traveling and everyday life with Hunner a joy. Regardless of the extensive training, Hunner is still a playful pup and keeps his personality during any times he is not actively in "training mode".

They even provide boarding services, which we used when my husband had to undergo surgery and we couldn't watch Hunner for a day. Angel made sure he was there to help, which also gave us peace knowing Hunner was in good hands.

We are incredibly grateful to Angel and the Camp Lucky team for their dedication and expertise. Without this training, we could never have imagined living such a peaceful, dog-friendly life. For anyone struggling with a high-energy or challenging dog, we wholeheartedly recommend Camp Lucky and Angel’s training. It’s a life-changing investment you won’t regret!

Not worth the price in my opinion, my dog was successful on the leash but that’s about it. I figured for $2800 my dog would come back trained with me having to minimally follow through and continue with training. I paid that amount because I’m a very busy woman who works 50+ hrs a week so time really isn’t on my side to have to continue her training. Although I did appreciate the updates of how my dog was doing I wouldn’t recommend training here.

Angel was the trainer for our sheepadoodle puppy, Pearl. He picked her up from us and after two weeks of training her he brought her back and then taught our family. During the board and train time we really loved getting the videos he would send of her. It helped us learn the training techniques and cues. The videos have been very helpful to us as we continue her training at home. Anything we asked about Angel was very helpful. He gave us instruction upon her return and we could see how to maintain and continue her education in our home environment. Our pup is so much better behaved and has no problem walking with us on long walks. She no longer counter surfs and recalls well.
Also Angel made one of our dreams come true when he came to our family photo session and helped us get our pup to pose with us in our family photos. She was super well behaved and looked right in the camera direction. Angel did a quick training review with her as we took individual photos and brought her in and out of our family group ones. We could never have gotten those priceless shots without his training! We are pleased with our puppy’s training and we are grateful to have Angel as a good friend of our family. Thank you again and again Angel.

I highly recommend Angel as a dog trainer. His expertise, patience, and positive reinforcement techniques have transformed my dog's behavior. Angel's ability to tailor training methods to my dog's individual needs and their consistent support throughout the process have made a significant difference. I have a 90 pound Bully Breed
